mu_name: The roots a Death Tree throws up on its second blow
mu_name_from: MapManager.cpp:331-332, WD_33AIDA: AccessModel(MODEL_TREE_ATTACK, Data/Object34/, tree_eff) - Data/Object34/tree_eff.bmd.
why_this_one: MODEL_TREE_ATTACK, which AttackEffectAidaMonster creates at a MONSTER_DEATH_TREE's feet on its ATTACK2, CheckAttackTime(10) (GMAida.cpp:1475-1484). game/fx/tree_roots.h draws it.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Object34/tree_eff.bmd, from MuMain's clean Data: one mesh, 808 vertices, 624 triangles on tree_effa01.jpg, one bone and one key; about 2.9 m across, 2.3 m deep and 2.5 m high from the ground up -- a burst of roots.

parts.note: Data/Object34/tree_effa01.OZJ, 32 x 64: grey-brown bark grain with teal tips. No _R, so not added: RenderObject draws it as a solid model with LightEnable false, unlit at full colour, at its Alpha (ZzzEffect.cpp:590-595, 8751-8753).

scale_from: Scale 0.05 at its birth, 20 units over the ground, up 0.1 a frame to 1; then Alpha down 0.07 a frame; LifeTime 20 (ZzzEffect.cpp:590-595, MoveHandlers.cpp:509-524).
